title: **🎉 New VIP Perks, Balance Changes & More**
body:
We're back with another batch of improvements! Here's a summary of the latest changes:

────────────────────────
🎁 **New VIP Kits**
────────────────────────

VIP players can now use:

➡️ **/kits**

This command is available in both **Ores** and **Survival Towny**, allowing you to claim exclusive rewards **every 14 days**.

Kits are **cumulative** based on your VIP rank. For example:

💎 **Diamond VIP** can claim:
• Diamond Kit
• Gold Kit
• Iron Kit
• Copper Kit

────────────────────────
⛏️ **Pickaxe Balance Changes**
────────────────────────

We've fixed an issue where certain **Rank F** pickaxes with **Efficiency VI** could instantly mine **Deepslate**, while higher-rank pickaxes could not.

The progression is now properly balanced:

• You'll need a **Rank A** pickaxe with **Efficiency VI** and **Haste II**, **or**
• A **Rank S** pickaxe with **Efficiency VI**.

This makes progression much more consistent across all ranks.

────────────────────────
🛒 **Shop Improvements**
────────────────────────

We've added several missing items to the spawn shops, along with a number of suggestions from the community.

────────────────────────
🛠️ **Other Changes**
────────────────────────

As always, we've also made various minor bug fixes, optimizations, and quality-of-life improvements to keep enhancing the gameplay experience.

Thank you for continuing to support RemoCraft! ❤️
author: RemoCraft Announcements

title: **📢 Recent Improvements & Updates**
body:
This announcement probably should have come a bit sooner, as we've added quite a few things over the last few days. Anyway, here's a summary of the latest updates!

────────────────────────
📱 **Bedrock Support is Here!**
────────────────────────

RemoCraft now supports **Minecraft Bedrock Edition**.

The server IP is still the same:

**play.remocraft.com**

If you're playing on Bedrock, simply use **port 2275**.

────────────────────────
⛏️ **Ores Updates**
────────────────────────

We've made several improvements to the **Ores** gamemode:

• Fixed various bugs.
• Rebalanced several custom items.
• Adjusted the drop rates of some crate rewards.

────────────────────────
🏘️ **Survival Towny Improvements**
────────────────────────

We've changed how players interact with NPCs.

NPCs now use a **graphical interface** instead of chat, since the previous system wasn't compatible with Bedrock players.

Additionally:

• Added new blocks to the **Builder** job.
• Fixed several graphical issues affecting some jobs.
• Resolved a variety of other small gameplay bugs.

────────────────────────
🛠️ **General Optimizations**
────────────────────────

We've also made many smaller improvements that you may not notice immediately:

• Bug fixes.
• Performance optimizations.
• Internal stability improvements.
• Various gameplay tweaks across different systems.

There are probably a few other minor changes we've forgotten to mention, but most of our recent work has been focused on **improving stability and polishing existing mechanics**, rather than introducing entirely new features.

Thank you for continuing to support RemoCraft and helping us improve the server! ❤️
author: RemoCraft Announcements

title: ** ⚔️⛏️ New Gamemode: Ores ⛏️⚔️ **
body:
Our new gamemode, **Ores**, is now available!

This gamemode is mainly focused on **PvP and progression**, with some mechanics that may remind some players of **BoxPvP**, although we've added our own systems and style.

⚠️ The gamemode is currently in **beta/alpha**, just like much of the server, but it is already fully playable and we believe it offers a very enjoyable experience.

---

## ⛏️ Infinite Mines

Inside the spawn area, you will find several **infinite mines** that automatically regenerate.

In addition, there are other mines located around the spawn area that provide better and more valuable resources.

There are also **special temporary mines**, which reset approximately every minute (or every few minutes) and contain rarer and more limited resources.

---

## 🛒 Shops and Progression

Inside the spawn, you'll find various shops where you can:

• Upgrade your armor
• Upgrade your weapons
• Purchase special weapons
• Obtain unique items
• Access additional systems that will be added over time

---

## 👑 KOTH (King of the Hill)

The gamemode includes a **King of the Hill (KOTH)** system.

• It can be contested approximately once every hour
• Rewards **clan points**
• Also grants an **exclusive event key**

---

## 🪙 Playtime Tokens

While playing, you will earn **tokens** simply by spending time online.

These tokens can be used to purchase various items and rewards, providing an alternative progression system alongside the normal economy.

---

## 🎁 Crates and More Content

The gamemode also includes:

• Crates
• Special rewards
• Unique items
• Progression systems
• And much more content that will be expanded over time

---

## 🚧 Current State

The gamemode is already fully playable, although there are still some aspects that need improvement:

• Additional decoration
• Some unfinished texts and messages
• Possible bugs that we did not discover during testing

If you encounter any issues, we would greatly appreciate you reporting them.

---

## 🚪 How to Join

You can currently access the gamemode:

• Through `/hub`
• By clicking the corresponding NPC in the main lobby

⚠️ It does not yet appear in the server selector menu because we are preparing a complete redesign of that menu, so adding it now would have been unnecessary.

---

⚔️ If you enjoy **PvP**, progression, obtaining better gear, and competing against other players, this gamemode is made for you.

We hope to see you there! 💚
author: RemoCraft Announcements

title: 🛠️ **Stability Update & Bug Fixes**
body:
We've got a few pieces of good news to share regarding the server's stability and ongoing migration process.

────────────────────────
✅ **XP Loss Bug**
────────────────────────

It's been a while since the bug where players could lose XP when switching servers has happened.

After a lot of testing, it looks like we've finally found the cause and fixed it. At this point, we believe the issue has been **solved or at least heavily minimized**.

⚠️ If it ever happens to you again, please let us know:
• The exact hour and minute it happened.
• Your time zone (or country).

This information is extremely helpful for tracking down rare synchronization issues.

────────────────────────
🔑 **Crate Keys & Item Restoration**
────────────────────────

Crate keys purchased from shops should now work correctly every time.

Additionally, if a custom item ever becomes corrupted, you can now simply use:

➡️ **/restoreitems**

Previously, this wasn't possible for crate keys, so this gives the server an extra layer of stability.

────────────────────────
🛠️ **Crafting Permission Fixes**
────────────────────────

We've also fixed an issue where a few custom items could not be crafted because certain jobs were not being granted the correct permissions.

If you previously met all the requirements for an item but still couldn't craft it, it should now work correctly.

────────────────────────
📚 **New Server Guides**
────────────────────────

We've started adding guides to help explain custom crafting recipes and server mechanics.

The first one available covers **Solid XP**:

https://www.remocraft.com/guides/survival_towny/solid_xp.html

Many more guides will be added over time.

────────────────────────
⚔️ **BedWars Fixes**
────────────────────────

We've fixed several small bugs in the BedWars arenas that could cause:
• Lag while playing.
• Money loss under certain circumstances.

────────────────────────
✨ **Solid XP is back!**
────────────────────────

Solid XP and other XP-consuming items are working again!

This one took quite a while to solve, but we've finally managed to get everything working properly. Sorry for the inconvenience it caused.

────────────────────────
🔨 **Current Priorities**
────────────────────────

Right now we're focusing our efforts on fixing two remaining issues:

• A bug where money can disappear when depositing into a Land.
• A translation bug where interacting with NPCs displays a strange message instead of the proper translated text.

We're currently waiting for responses from the plugin developers. If we don't receive support within a reasonable time, we'll look for alternative solutions, even if that means purchasing additional plugins.

As always, thank you for your patience and for continuing to help us improve RemoCraft ❤️
author: RemoCraft Announcements

title: 📢✨ **Crafting & Enchantments System Update** ✨📢
body:
To improve the crafting system and prevent the issues we've been experiencing, we have had to **completely rebuild the enchantment slot system**.

────────────────────────
🛠️ **New Item Restoration System**
────────────────────────

➡️ **/restoreitems**

This command will detect all custom items in your inventory and automatically restore them.

⚠️ **Exceptions:**
• Items that already have enchantments applied.
• Items with Armor Trims.
• Items whose maximum enchantment slots have been modified.

────────────────────────
🔮 **Enchanter Improvements**
────────────────────────

The **Enchanter** job now correctly detects custom enchantments.

────────────────────────
🌐 **New Official Website**
────────────────────────

**www.remocraft.com**

We will use it to publish announcements, guides, important links, and other server information.

────────────────────────
⚡ **New Enchantment Slot System**
────────────────────────

• You now need **250 levels** instead of 500.
• The **Luck** system still works.
• Once you obtain the result, the item will have a **100% chance to add the slot**.

Previously, it was possible to obtain items that only added the slot with reduced chances, such as **10%**.

➡️ **Shift + right-click** an enchanting table to view an item's slot count.

────────────────────────
🐛 **Bug Reports**
────────────────────────

If you find any bugs or strange behavior, please report them.

Thank you for your patience and for helping improve RemoCraft ❤️
author: RemoCraft Announcements
